title: Create User: the permission set is a free text box that only accepts the machine name
body:
epic:#26676#1 · zhuangjianguo · session_cdb7a717def74e719988f089fbaa18ff

From a real-user walkthrough of the development flow, filed on the maintainer's word: 「第一组：会卡住人或误导人，立卡」 (2026-11-04). Measured on `main` `987ff33b88` unless a line says otherwise. Test project scaffolded with `create-objectstack@18.3.0`.

## What a customer sees

An administrator creates a user and reaches 权限集. It is an empty text box. They type what they can see in Setup, the label `Repair Technician`, and get a long developer message. Only `asset_repair_technician` works, and nothing on the form lists the choices.

## Measured

`POST /api/v1/actions/sys_user/create_user` with `permissionSet: 'Repair Technician'` answers 400:

> The permission set was not assigned, so no user was created: Permission Set: no permission set is named 'Repair Technician'. sys_user_permission_set.permission_set takes the machine name of a permission set in the security catalog (a package's set, a built-in, or one saved through the metadata door), never a record id…

The refusal is atomic, and that part is right: no user is created. The form itself was seen on the published 18.3.0. On `main`, `packages/platform-objects/src/identity/sys-user.object.ts:365` still declares `name: 'permissionSet', type: 'text'`. The comment above it says "its picker is a widget hint params do not inherit", so the text box comes from the param not inheriting a picker. It is not a decision that typing is better.

Duplicate search: #25338 added the param; #27521 row 16 is about the permission set editor and not this field.

## Expected

The field is a searchable list of the permission sets this administrator may grant, showing each label. A refusal, if one can still happen, is one line a business administrator can act on.
